label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
To: @marco
Replying to: i02
Cc: none
Subject: none

Marco. Desert Palms. You told me 14 units all good Saturday and there is not one code in the sheet. Lupe checked this morning. Last thing you logged was Ortiz Tire on the 12th.

Yvette called at 7:50. Tenant in 9B lost her key and wants 3 copies today. I got nothing to cut from. So now I'm calling the leasing office to tell them we can't do it yet on a job we just did two days ago. That makes us look like we don't know what we're doing.

This is the second time. Kessler in September, same exact thing, and I told you then. In August I put it out to everybody: codes go in the sheet same day, before you leave the van, address unit and code. I said no exceptions. That wasn't a suggestion and it wasn't for everybody but you.

And you left your pinning tray on the counter in her office. Pins and all, sitting out where anybody can mess with it.

I'm not going to pretend I'm not pissed because I am. You're good with your hands, I know that, that's why you're here. I'm not looking to get rid of you. But this can't keep happening. Those codes are the job. If they're only in your head, or nowhere, the work's not done. Doesn't matter how clean the install was.

Here's what you're doing today:

1. Go back out to Desert Palms this morning. Decode 9B first so we can get that tenant her keys. If you can get all 14, do all 14.
2. Put every one in the code sheet before you leave the property. Address, unit, code.
3. Get my tray back from Yvette and bring it to the shop.
4. Text me when 9B is in so I can get the copies going.

Call me if you got a problem with any of that. Otherwise I expect to see those codes in the sheet today.

Ray
